name: Specialist Domain Engines
purpose: High-precision computational and scientific reasoning for Mathematics, Natural Science, Programming, Research, and Indian Cultural Ethics.
registration: SpecialistEngines::new instantiates and aggregates all 5 specialized domain engines.
discovery: SpecialistEngines::dispatch inspects intent and keywords to route queries to relevant specialist.
memory_link: Specialist derivations stored as structured evidence in episodic turn records.
learning_link: Novel research findings autonomously queued for continual training data synthesis.
self_evolution_link: ProgrammingEngine inspects system source code for AST optimizations during code evolution.
curriculum_link: Directly implements the academic domains in master_curriculum.jsonl.
safety_gates: CultureEngine enforces filial respect, honorifics, and ethical values
ProgrammingEngine linter verifies bracket balancing and memory safety
ResearchEngine verifies source citations and PRISMA methodology

lifecycle.1_route: Cognitive loop Step 7 detects domain-specific problem
lifecycle.2_parse: Specialist engine parses formal notation (LaTeX, AST, formulas)
lifecycle.3_compute: Deterministic algorithms compute exact derivations / solutions
lifecycle.4_verify: Self-verification step proves mathematical / scientific soundness
lifecycle.6_emit: Structured derivation handed to neural generator for coherent presentation
